editorial:
Imagine finding out you inherited a big house from a family you never even knew existed. That is exactly what happens to Samantha Harris. She grabs three of her closest friends and drives out to the quiet town of Sader Ridge to check out the place. At first, it seems like a great deal, but the vibe changes fast. Once you step inside, you can feel that something is very wrong. Sam starts seeing scary flashes of violence and evil things that happened years ago. It feels like the house is trying to tell her a dark secret, and the more she digs, the more the house pushes back with terrifying visions.

You will notice that the movie relies heavily on jump scares and a creepy atmosphere to keep you on edge. The acting is decent for this kind of flick, though some parts feel a bit slow before the chaos hits. If you love movies where a group of friends gets trapped in a cursed place, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Sam discovers her family history is tied to a dark cult. The demons in the house want to use her as a vessel to return to the world. In the final scenes, Sam has to fight off the evil spirits to save her friends. After a big struggle, she manages to break the cycle of violence, but the ending leaves you wondering if the evil is truly gone or just waiting for the next person.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves haunted house stories and supernatural mysteries.
